message.belts.tunnel_entry_stored: Stored tunnel entry. Shift + Right-Click the exit tunnel to link.
message.belts.tunnel_unavailable: Tunnel is unavailable or already linked.
message.belts.tunnel_invalid: Tunnels must be aligned on a straight horizontal line.
message.belts.tunnel_too_far: Tunnels are too far apart for this tier.
message.belts.tunnel_blocked: The path between the tunnels is blocked.
item.belts.chute.tooltip: Attach this to any inventory block. Belts are attached to this.
block.belts.chute.tooltip.1: [Right-Click] with an item to set it as filter.
block.belts.chute.tooltip.ftbfilters: Supports smart filters from the 'FTB Filters' mod.
item.belts.conveyor_support.tooltip: Used to guide conveyor belt paths.
item.belts.foundry_splitter.tooltip: Splits items from the back into two outputs. [Right-Click] an output side with an item to filter it, [Right-Click] with Redstone to upgrade. Empty hand cycles input priority, [Shift] + empty hand cycles output priority.
item.belts.foundry_tunnel.tooltip: Transports items between two linked tunnels. [Shift] + [Right-Click] the entry, then the exit to link. [Right-Click] with Redstone to upgrade range.
item.belts.foundry_loader.tooltip: Pulls items from the inventory behind it and pushes them forward. [Right-Click] with an item to filter, with Redstone to upgrade. Empty hand cycles the lane, [Shift] + empty hand resets the filter.
item.belts.belt.tooltip.0: Use this to create conveyor belts of any shape and size. Automatically places Item Chutes at the start and end (items optional).
item.belts.belt.tooltip.1: Click existing chutes to mark them as start/end. Click conveyor supports to add optional midpoints.
item.belts.belt.tooltip.2: [Shift] + [Right-Click] without targeting a block to reset.
item.belts.belt.tooltip.3: Existing connected chutes can be clicked with an item to enable filtering.
item.belts.improved_belt.tooltip.0: A Mark 2 conveyor belt with twice the movement speed and transport capacity.
item.belts.improved_belt.tooltip.1: Connects to the same Item Chutes and Conveyor Supports as a standard belt.
item.belts.improved_belt.tooltip.2: [Shift] + [Right-Click] without targeting a block to reset.
item.belts.improved_belt.tooltip.3: Existing connected chutes can be clicked with an item to enable filtering.
item.belts.belt_tier3.tooltip.0: A Mark 3 conveyor belt with three times the movement speed and transport capacity.
item.belts.belt_tier3.tooltip.1: Connects to the same Item Chutes and Conveyor Supports as a standard belt.
item.belts.belt_tier3.tooltip.2: [Shift] + [Right-Click] without targeting a block to reset.
item.belts.belt_tier3.tooltip.3: Existing connected chutes can be clicked with an item to enable filtering.
item.belts.belt_tier4.tooltip.0: A Mark 4 conveyor belt with four times the movement speed and transport capacity.
item.belts.belt_tier4.tooltip.1: Connects to the same Item Chutes and Conveyor Supports as a standard belt.
item.belts.belt_tier4.tooltip.2: [Shift] + [Right-Click] without targeting a block to reset.
item.belts.belt_tier4.tooltip.3: Existing connected chutes can be clicked with an item to enable filtering.
